blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.27
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.27

blocks.text: कथा जपः
blocks.directed: [slowly] कथा जपः

blocks.text: Kathā japaḥ.
blocks.directed: Kathā japaḥ.

blocks.text: Conversation is mantra-recitation.
blocks.directed: Conversation is mantra-recitation.

blocks.text: Every Conversation Is a Mantra. You’ve Been Chanting the Entire Time, You Absolute Donut.
blocks.directed: Every Conversation Is a Mantra. You’ve Been Chanting the Entire Time, You Absolute Donut.

blocks.text: OH, THIS IS GLORIOUS.
blocks.directed: OH, THIS IS GLORIOUS.

blocks.text: Absolutely glorious.
blocks.directed: Absolutely glorious.

blocks.text: Two words.
blocks.directed: Two words.

blocks.text: Katha.
blocks.directed: Katha.

blocks.text: Speech, conversation, discourse.
blocks.directed: Speech, conversation, discourse.

blocks.text: Japa.
blocks.directed: Japa.

blocks.text: Repetition or recitation of mantra.
blocks.directed: Repetition or recitation of mantra.

blocks.text: And Vasugupta announces:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And Vasugupta announces:

blocks.text: Kathā japaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Kathā japaḥ.

blocks.text: Conversation is japa.
blocks.directed: Conversation is japa.

blocks.text: Now, if you take that out of context, it’s completely ridiculous.
blocks.directed: Now, if you take that out of context, it’s completely ridiculous.

blocks.text: Imagine somebody spending three hours complaining about the weather.
blocks.directed: Imagine somebody spending three hours complaining about the weather.

blocks.text: And announcing:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And announcing:

blocks.text: “Actually, I have just performed three hours of supreme tantric mantra practice.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Actually, I have just performed three hours of supreme tantric mantra practice.”

blocks.text: Well.
blocks.directed: Well.

blocks.text: Not quite.
blocks.directed: Not quite.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja makes a very important qualification.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja makes a very important qualification.

blocks.text: We’re talking about the speech of the yogi established in recognition of supreme I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: We’re talking about the speech of the yogi established in recognition of supreme I-consciousness.

blocks.text: And this is where the whole philosophical journey becomes extraordinarily beautiful.
blocks.directed: And this is where the whole philosophical journey becomes extraordinarily beautiful.

blocks.text: Remember the beginning of Book II?
blocks.directed: Remember the beginning of Book II?

blocks.text: चित्तं मन्त्रः।
blocks.directed: [slowly] चित्तं मन्त्रः।

blocks.text: Cittaṃ mantraḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Cittaṃ mantraḥ.

blocks.text: The mind is mantra.
blocks.directed: The mind is mantra.

blocks.text: Now, in Book III:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now, in Book III:

blocks.text: कथा जपः।
blocks.directed: [slowly] कथा जपः।

blocks.text: Kathā japaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Kathā japaḥ.

blocks.text: Speech is mantra-recitation.
blocks.directed: Speech is mantra-recitation.

blocks.text: The same basic transformation is being expressed at a more complete level.
blocks.directed: The same basic transformation is being expressed at a more complete level.

blocks.text: The mind no longer simply produces differentiated cognitions that reinforce bondage.
blocks.directed: The mind no longer simply produces differentiated cognitions that reinforce bondage.

blocks.text: It becomes an instrument of recognition.
blocks.directed: It becomes an instrument of recognition.

blocks.text: And now even ordinary speech can arise from the uninterrupted awareness of the supreme Self.
blocks.directed: And now even ordinary speech can arise from the uninterrupted awareness of the supreme Self.

blocks.text: But here’s the really important part.
blocks.directed: But here’s the really important part.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja connects this with the Mahāmantra.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja connects this with the Mahāmantra.

blocks.text: The great mantra of universal I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: The great mantra of universal I-consciousness.

blocks.text: Aham.
blocks.directed: Aham.

blocks.text: I.
blocks.directed: I.

blocks.text: Not the little ego.
blocks.directed: Not the little ego.

blocks.text: Not the ordinary personality.
blocks.directed: Not the ordinary personality.

blocks.text: But the primordial I-consciousness of Śiva.
blocks.directed: But the primordial I-consciousness of Śiva.

blocks.text: And within the Trika understanding, this I-consciousness is inseparable from the manifestation of the universe.
blocks.directed: And within the Trika understanding, this I-consciousness is inseparable from the manifestation of the universe.

blocks.text: Now imagine the yogi speaking.
blocks.directed: Now imagine the yogi speaking.

blocks.text: The words arise.
blocks.directed: The words arise.

blocks.text: They may concern ordinary things.
blocks.directed: They may concern ordinary things.

blocks.text: Food.
blocks.directed: Food.

blocks.text: Travel.
blocks.directed: Travel.

blocks.text: A philosophical discussion.
blocks.directed: A philosophical discussion.

blocks.text: A question.
blocks.directed: A question.

blocks.text: An answer.
blocks.directed: An answer.

blocks.text: But throughout the movement of speech, the yogi remains established in the universal conscious source.
blocks.directed: But throughout the movement of speech, the yogi remains established in the universal conscious source.

blocks.text: So the verbal activity no longer obscures that source.
blocks.directed: So the verbal activity no longer obscures that source.

blocks.text: Instead, it becomes an expression of the uninterrupted recognition of Śiva.
blocks.directed: Instead, it becomes an expression of the uninterrupted recognition of Śiva.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja cites the Kālikākrama to explain that the yogi’s speech constitutes japa because it arises from the continual apprehension of the great mantra’s deity as one’s own Self.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja cites the Kālikākrama to explain that the yogi’s speech constitutes japa because it arises from the continual apprehension of the great mantra’s deity as one’s own Self.

blocks.text: This is very different from mechanically repeating a formula.
blocks.directed: This is very different from mechanically repeating a formula.

blocks.text: The highest japa is inseparable from recognition.
blocks.directed: The highest japa is inseparable from recognition.

blocks.text: And then he cites the Vijñānabhairava.
blocks.directed: And then he cites the Vijñānabhairava.

blocks.text: Which is where things become particularly interesting.
blocks.directed: Which is where things become particularly interesting.

blocks.text: Because the text describes spontaneous mantra in relation to the movement of breath.
blocks.directed: Because the text describes spontaneous mantra in relation to the movement of breath.

blocks.text: Haṃsa.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Haṃsa.

blocks.text: The subtle mantra associated with the natural movement of respiration.
blocks.directed: The subtle mantra associated with the natural movement of respiration.

blocks.text: In a traditional account, the outgoing and incoming breaths are correlated with the syllables sa and ha, producing the continuous mantra of life.
blocks.directed: In a traditional account, the outgoing and incoming breaths are correlated with the syllables sa and ha, producing the continuous mantra of life.

blocks.text: And the text gives the traditional daily count:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the text gives the traditional daily count:

blocks.text: 21,600 repetitions.
blocks.directed: 21,600 repetitions.

blocks.text: Now, this is a conventional yogic calculation based on an assumed average breathing rhythm, not a universal physiological measurement applicable to every human being.
blocks.directed: Now, this is a conventional yogic calculation based on an assumed average breathing rhythm, not a universal physiological measurement applicable to every human being.

blocks.text: But its symbolic significance is extraordinary.
blocks.directed: But its symbolic significance is extraordinary.

blocks.text: The living being is understood as continually participating in an unspoken mantra.
blocks.directed: The living being is understood as continually participating in an unspoken mantra.

blocks.text: Breathing itself becomes associated with the divine power of manifestation.
blocks.directed: Breathing itself becomes associated with the divine power of manifestation.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja relates this to the higher understanding of japa as uninterrupted contemplation of the supreme reality. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja relates this to the higher understanding of japa as uninterrupted contemplation of the supreme reality. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: Now consider the progression.
blocks.directed: Now consider the progression.

blocks.text: Ordinarily, a mantra seems to be something you deliberately repeat.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, a mantra seems to be something you deliberately repeat.

blocks.text: You sit down.
blocks.directed: You sit down.

blocks.text: You count the syllables.
blocks.directed: You count the syllables.

blocks.text: You focus your attention.
blocks.directed: You focus your attention.

blocks.text: You try to maintain concentration.
blocks.directed: You try to maintain concentration.

blocks.text: But in the condition described here, the yogi’s awareness of the divine is no longer restricted to deliberate recitation.
blocks.directed: But in the condition described here, the yogi’s awareness of the divine is no longer restricted to deliberate recitation.

blocks.text: Speech itself becomes an expression of recognition.
blocks.directed: Speech itself becomes an expression of recognition.

blocks.text: And this is magnificent.
blocks.directed: And this is magnificent.

blocks.text: Because it means the sacred is no longer confined to special verbal formulas.
blocks.directed: Because it means the sacred is no longer confined to special verbal formulas.

blocks.text: Not because the formulas have become meaningless.
blocks.directed: Not because the formulas have become meaningless.

blocks.text: But because the conscious source of all speech has been recognised.
blocks.directed: But because the conscious source of all speech has been recognised.

blocks.text: The mantra is no longer merely an activity performed at particular times.
blocks.directed: The mantra is no longer merely an activity performed at particular times.

blocks.text: The underlying I-consciousness is apprehended as continuously present.
blocks.directed: The underlying I-consciousness is apprehended as continuously present.

blocks.text: And here’s the funniest thing.
blocks.directed: And here’s the funniest thing.

blocks.text: You can be talking about something completely ordinary.
blocks.directed: You can be talking about something completely ordinary.

blocks.text: And the philosophical meaning is transformed by the standpoint from which the speech arises.
blocks.directed: And the philosophical meaning is transformed by the standpoint from which the speech arises.

blocks.text: Imagine a realised yogi asking:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Imagine a realised yogi asking:

blocks.text: “Could you pass the salt?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Could you pass the salt?”

blocks.text: An entirely ordinary sentence.
blocks.directed: An entirely ordinary sentence.

blocks.text: No Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: No Sanskrit.

blocks.text: No bells.
blocks.directed: No bells.

blocks.text: No elaborate mudrās.
blocks.directed: No elaborate mudrās.

blocks.text: Not even a particularly mystical tone of voice.
blocks.directed: Not even a particularly mystical tone of voice.

blocks.text: But within Kṣemarāja’s understanding, the speech of such a yogi is not separate from the continuous contemplation of Śiva.
blocks.directed: But within Kṣemarāja’s understanding, the speech of such a yogi is not separate from the continuous contemplation of Śiva.

blocks.text: The salt is still salt.
blocks.directed: The salt is still salt.

blocks.text: The request still means what it means.
blocks.directed: The request still means what it means.

blocks.text: The linguistic function remains perfectly ordinary.
blocks.directed: The linguistic function remains perfectly ordinary.

blocks.text: But the awareness underlying the act is not limited by the ordinary identification with separate selfhood.
blocks.directed: But the awareness underlying the act is not limited by the ordinary identification with separate selfhood.

blocks.text: And thus ordinary discourse can be understood as japa.
blocks.directed: And thus ordinary discourse can be understood as japa.

blocks.text: Now, we should not flatten the teaching into:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now, we should not flatten the teaching into:

blocks.text: “Everything you say is a mantra, therefore say whatever you like.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Everything you say is a mantra, therefore say whatever you like.”

blocks.text: That would be a rather spectacular misunderstanding.
blocks.directed: That would be a rather spectacular misunderstanding.

blocks.text: The condition of recognition comes first.
blocks.directed: The condition of recognition comes first.

blocks.text: The transformation of speech follows from it.
blocks.directed: The transformation of speech follows from it.

blocks.text: And this is why the text doesn’t simply teach a new religious ritual.
blocks.directed: And this is why the text doesn’t simply teach a new religious ritual.

blocks.text: It teaches a transformation of the conscious standpoint from which activity occurs.
blocks.directed: It teaches a transformation of the conscious standpoint from which activity occurs.

blocks.text: The body continues as a vow.
blocks.directed: The body continues as a vow.

blocks.text: Speech becomes japa.
blocks.directed: Speech becomes japa.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta announces what the realised yogi gives to others.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta announces what the realised yogi gives to others.

blocks.text: And it’s not money.
blocks.directed: And it’s not money.

blocks.text: Not supernatural powers.
blocks.directed: Not supernatural powers.

blocks.text: Not a complicated initiation certificate.
blocks.directed: Not a complicated initiation certificate.

blocks.text: Self-knowledge.
blocks.directed: Self-knowledge.

blocks.text: The highest gift.
blocks.directed: The highest gift.
